subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: oh mamma what beautiful roses wont you buy some of them said rosamond no my dear mother said why the girl said mother replied because i dont want them they are not real flowers Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: "Oh, Mamma, what beautiful roses! Won't you buy some of them?" said Rosamond. "No, my dear," mother said. "Why?" the girl said. Mother replied, "Because I don't want them. They are not real flowers." ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
